items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the fppf version of the proper push-pull identity, deduced from the etale case (statement lines 21513-21517). The proof (proof lines 21519-21543) reduces by the reflection of isomorphisms through epsilon_{Y,*} and the description of the pullbacks, then identifies the four-term composite with part (1) of the proper comparison lemma. H2: one reduction and one identification.
